notes.title: v1.7.1 Patch and Sequel Update
notes.content:
[i]Prism Indigo DX[/i] has been patched to v1.7.1. This fixes a dialogue mistake that, rather embarrassingly, was displayed in one of the screenshots on the store page without me noticing it until two days ago. (Mind you, at least nobody [i]else[/i] noticed!) I also made a few other small tweaks while I was at it, including replacing the game's favicon with a much clearer one.

If you're following me on any of my social media, you'll be aware that I'm working on a sequel, [i]Prism Warriors[/i]. Development was stalled for a while, but is now back in full swing. I'm aiming to launch its Steam page within the next few weeks, and the game itself should be out before the end of the year. I hope you'll look forward to it, as it promises to be much bigger and better than [i]Prism Indigo[/i].

Without further ado, here are the patch notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]V1.7.1 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Improved the look of Prism Amber’s shield
    [*]Updated a few achievement icons that still used the pre-1.2.0a bullet sprites
    [*]Updated the name of one of the Sound Test songs to match its name in the Soundtrack DLC
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed one of Prism Amber’s dialogue lines being incorrectly attributed to Prism Indigo
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Updated a screenshot on the store page that showed the dialogue mistake
    [*]Changed the favicon to Prism Indigo’s sprite for better readability
[/list]

notes.title: Prism Indigo DX is out now!
notes.content:
The day is finally here! Prism Indigo DX is out now on Steam, with a 10% discount until May 27th!

[previewyoutube=Hg0-a_VKbqA;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate, and to ensure the game is in the best state possible, the game has been updated to v1.7. Details of the update are listed at the bottom of the announcement.

For me, getting to release a game on Steam is the culmination of almost 20 years of game development. I'd like to thank everyone who has supported me on this journey - and if you're reading this, that includes you, too! I hope that this will be the first of many Steam releases to come.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]V1.7 Update Notes[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
    [*]"Exit Game" menu option (DX version only)
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Locked achievements are now shaded out
    [*]Icons for locked Compendium entries are now shaded out
    [*]Toned down some of the Stage 6 waves
    [*]Improved the Options menu interface
    [*]Adjusted the alignment of various menus
    [*]Bolded the titles on the game mode and difficulty menus
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed visual flicker when exiting the Sound Test menu
[/list]
